data.summary: “МУЖИК СДЕЛАЛ ДОБРОЕ ДЕЛО🤘” has pulled 10,937,801 views at ~207,570/hour — well above a normal upload. It reads as a challenge whose strongest lever is velocity. The breakdown below frames the rest as likely contributors, not proven causes.

why_trending.detail: Views are accumulating far faster than a typical upload, and that early velocity likely compounds into broader recommendation.
A high-contrast thumbnail with a clear focal subject likely lifts the initial tap rate against a busy Shorts feed.
A tight, fast cold-open with the payoff up front likely sustains the watch-through that Shorts distribution favors.
The topic taps a timely, high-interest subject, so audience intent is likely already searching for and engaging with it.
